tools.name: plan_create
tools.intent: After decomposing a task brief into steps with acceptance criteria, when the plan should become the graph execution lanes dispatch from.

tools.name: plan_replace
tools.intent: Before execution starts, when review feedback changes the step set — replaces the whole plan under an expected-revision check.

tools.name: plan_get
tools.intent: First read after a gap or handoff: counts, ready set, blocked steps and the current revision before any mutation.

tools.name: plan_export
tools.intent: At a review or release boundary, to get the canonical stored plan document, schema URL included, as an artifact.

tools.name: step_get
tools.intent: When one step's instructions, dependencies, blockers or criteria must be seen in full — cheaper than exporting the whole plan.

tools.name: step_start
tools.intent: Take a ready step just before dispatching a lane so in_progress and started_at are recorded; after a failure this is a retry.

tools.name: step_complete
tools.intent: When a lane's verification passed: record the evidence and per-criterion results that close the step; force is the only way past failed criteria.

tools.name: step_fail
tools.intent: When a lane could not deliver: record the reason and evidence so dependents show blocked instead of silently waiting.

tools.name: step_skip
tools.intent: When a step is deliberately not done (superseded, descoped): skipped still satisfies readiness, unlike failed.

tools.name: ac_check
tools.intent: During verification, per acceptance criterion: record passed or failed with evidence while the step is in progress; completion freezes it.

tools.name: steps_ready
tools.intent: Before each wave dispatch: the ready frontier, waves packed around file and resource conflicts, and steps blocked by failures.

tools.name: progress_checklist
tools.intent: For a status report or checkpoint: per-step markers, criterion tallies, next and blocked — the text format is the status section verbatim.
